title: Calibration
description: A committed real-world time-series baseline used to compare engine output against historical data. No engine-computed values appear here — only observed economic data.

name.description: Localization key for the calibration title.

desc.description: Localization key for the calibration description.

source.description: Canonical URL for the data source. Pattern-enforced because AJV 8 strict mode silently ignores unknown formats and ajv-formats is not installed.

series.description: Monthly observations. Strict ascending order by `date` is enforced by `loadCalibration` at runtime, not by this schema.

inflation_yoy.description: Year-over-year CPI inflation rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.1184 = 11.84%).

unemployment.description: Civilian unemployment rate as a decimal in [0, 1].

fed_funds_rate.description: Effective federal funds rate as a decimal in [0, 2].
